description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Airbender Ascension. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Airbender Ascension
uses.cardState: with four or more quest counters on it
